name: jrxml-editor-extension
description: Syntax highlighting, bracket colorization, and expression formatter for JasperReports .jrxml files

commands.title: JRXML: Sort Band/Frame Elements by Position
JRXML: Apply Clear Fixes (unused declarations, descriptions, jsonql)
JRXML: Migrate SQL Query to jsonql

jrxml.autoOpenEditor.description: Automatically open expression editor when cursor is inside an expression

jrxml.showUnusedWarnings.description: Show warnings for declared fields, parameters, or variables that are never used in any expression.

jrxml.validateExpressions.description: Show errors for unbalanced parentheses, unclosed strings, and undeclared $F/$P/$V references.

jrxml.lint.constantPrintWhen.description: Warn when a <printWhenExpression> is a constant 'true' or 'false'.

jrxml.lint.removeLineWhenBlank.description: Warn when a textField or subreport element is missing removeLineWhenBlank="true".

jrxml.lint.markupTagWithoutMarkup.description: Warn when a textField expression contains markup tags but markup is not "styled", "html" or "rtf".

jrxml.lint.nullDereference.description: Warn when a $F/$P/$V reference is used as a method-call receiver without a dominating null check.

jrxml.format.reportName.description: Formatting: set jasperReport/@name to the file base name.

jrxml.format.positionType.description: Formatting: add/set positionType="Float" on textField and subreport elements.

jrxml.format.textAdjust.description: Formatting: add/set textAdjust="StretchHeight" on textField elements.

jrxml.format.expression.description: Formatting: normalise operator, ternary, comma and cast spacing inside expressions.

jrxml.textcheck.enabled.description: Text check: replace unrenderable characters, fix period spacing, collapse double spaces and normalize newlines in text and string literals.

jrxml.textcheck.diagnostics.description: Show warnings with quick fixes for text-check problems (double spaces, missing space after '.', unrenderable characters, newlines) in <text> CDATA and string literals.

jrxml.formatOnSave.description: Run the format + textcheck steps when saving a .jrxml file (never the clear or sort steps).

jrxml.sort.preview.description: Show a diff and ask for confirmation before applying the geometry sort (the sort rewrites the whole file).

jrxml.clear.preview.description: Show a diff and ask for confirmation before applying clear fixes or a SQL->jsonql migration.

jrxml.migrate.targetLanguage.description: Language written to <query language="..."> when migrating a SQL query.

jrxml.suppressedBestPractices.description: List of best practice rule IDs whose yellow squiggles are hidden. Quick fixes remain available.
